subject: general
question: When did the Swadeshi Movement begin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1905**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Swadeshi Movement began in the year **1905**.
 
• It was a part of the Indian independence movement and aimed at removing the British Empire from power by following the principles of swadeshi or self-sufficiency.
 
• The movement involved the boycott of British products and the revival of domestic products and production processes.
 
• It was initiated as a response to the partition of Bengal announced by Lord Curzon in 1905.
 
• The Swadeshi Movement played a crucial role in fostering Indian nationalism and encouraging the use of Indian goods and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Swadeshi Movement was one of the first organized movements in India against British rule.
 
• Prominent leaders such as Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Bipin Chandra Pal, Lala Lajpat Rai, and Aurobindo Ghosh were key figures in the movement.
 
• It led to the establishment of several Indian institutions and industries, including educational institutions, banks, and textile mills.
 
• The movement laid the foundation for future large-scale campaigns against British rule, including the Non-Cooperation Movement and the Civil Disobedience Movement.
 
• It also had a significant impact on the Indian economy by promoting the use of indigenous goods and reducing dependency on British imports.
